about: The player's base (design guide: the vardo, our HUB): a compact Irish Traveller barrel-top living wagon with a structural grown-wood roof, drawn by the cyber-cob. Towing end (shafts) at the model's front, entrance at the rear. Brief: docs/art/vardo-and-cyber-cob.md.

sockets.Door: the rear doorway at sill height
sockets.Hitch: where the cob stands between the shafts

lights.Vardo_Window: window and interior glow (authored at peak)
lights.Vardo_Lantern: the rear lantern (LanternFlame, extras light: lantern)

acoustics.about: large near-level meshes carry glTF extras acoustic; trim, motifs, foliage, gear and wheels' small parts are left out
